finalText:
Build's clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under all those deprecation warnings, both from the bundler bump changing shapes it handed to your code.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. That's now fixed.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing flag as an error instead of "off". The old loader sent `false` for unset flags, the new one sends `undefined`. Now both mean disabled.

The rest was just noisy deprecation warnings, safe to ignore. Build finishes in 44.9s with 0 errors.
